channel.title: Sidhu's Views
channel.description: A curated personal online magazine exploring lifestyle, style, crafting, storytelling, and digital experiments by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: The Balcony Chai Corner: ₹1,500 में कैसे बनाया मैंने अपना 4x6 का Cozy Tea Haven
item.description: Drying racks को बेदखल करने, कबूतरों से peace treaty साइन करने, और एक honest budget में 4x6 बालकनी को cozy chai sanctuary बनाने की कहानी। लेखिका: गुरदीप सिधू

item.title: The Great Sunday Samosa Mystery: जब 90s में मेरे भाई ने कर दिया था 'समोसा कांड'
item.description: 90s के बचपन की एक सच्ची और मज़ेदार याद—ना मोबाइल का शोर, ना रोज़-रोज़ फास्ट फूड की इजाज़त। जब भाई ने कर दिया समोसा कांड। लेखिका: गुरदीप सिधू

item.title: The Balcony Chai Corner: Reclaiming Your 4x6 Sanctuary for Under ₹1,500
item.description: A humorous, heartwarming guide by Gurdeep Sidhu on evicting laundry racks, outsmarting neighborhood pigeons, and building a cozy balcony chai haven under Rs 1,500.

item.title: Notes from a Highway Dhaba: Tea, Parathas & Life on the Open Road
item.description: A lighthearted, warm, and simple travel story about stopping at a Punjabi highway dhaba. Hot tandoori parathas, clay kulhad chai, woven cots under neem trees, and funny highway memories by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: How to Crochet an Easy Square Coaster: Beginner Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: A clear, professional step-by-step tutorial for crocheting an aesthetic 4x4 square cotton coaster. Exact stitch counts, US terminology, step photos, and wet blocking tips by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: The Beginner's Guide to Cozy Crochet: Stitches, Yarns & Easy First Projects
item.description: Master the art of crochet with our ultimate beginner guide. Learn essential stitches, how to choose yarn and hooks, and make 3 beautiful beginner projects step-by-step.

item.title: How to Make Your Room Look Aesthetic on a Budget (Under Rs 5000)
item.description: Transform your room into an aesthetic, Instagram-worthy space without spending a fortune. Real budget room decor ideas under Rs 2000 to Rs 5000 that actually work in Indian homes — lighting, plants, wall art, textiles and more.

item.title: The Art of the Reading Nook: Creating a Quiet Haven at Home
item.description: A warm, lighthearted guide by Gurdeep Sidhu on creating the ultimate cozy reading nook—armchairs, 2700K warm lighting, chai side tables, and bookshelf curation.

item.title: Sainj Valley: The Quiet Himalayan Escape
item.description: Discover Sainj Valley & Shangarh Meadow in Himachal Pradesh—a slow travel guide to pine forests, Kathkuni temples, mountain tea, and Himalayan quietude.

item.title: The Gentle Art of a Slow Morning: Simple Stories & Peaceful Rituals
item.description: A simple, beautiful story about slow mornings, warm tea, quiet windows, and how 30 peaceful minutes can bring joy to your day. Written in clear, charming everyday English by Gurdeep Sidhu.

item.title: The Great Sunday Samosa Mystery: A Funny 90s Childhood Memory
item.description: An authentic 90s childhood memory by Gurdeep Sidhu: no mobile phones, a rare outside samosa treat, angry eyes at the door, and an unbothered brother who only cared about lunch.
